post_text:
The St. Regis Dubai, The Palm welcomes guests again today, 1 November, after six months of works.

The hotel on Palm Jumeirah closed its rooms, spa and key services on 12 April. Only the lobby lounge and the St. Regis Bar stayed open.

The bar is the centrepiece of the return. Its new design carries photographic frames inspired by Manhattan, a nod to the brand's first address in New York. A pianist plays four evenings a week, and the cocktail list mixes signatures with new creations.

The St. Regis Spa reopens too, alongside Cordelia for all-day dining, RÜYA and its Turkish-inspired cuisine, KYMA Beach Club and St. Regis Gardens, a rooftop of chef-led and Michelin-starred concepts.

The signal: @St. Regis Hotels & Resorts, part of @Marriott International, has timed the return to the start of Dubai's winter season. On Palm Jumeirah, where competition for that clientele is fierce, a renewed product is the strongest argument.

Is a six-month closure worth it to come back with a renewed hotel?
